kim_large_library.efficiency_units: per cent in file, divided by 100 here

optiprime_endogenous_panel.verdict: Confirms the plan's inventory: 283 endogenous design rows with spacer, scaffold, RTT, PBS, motif and nicking guide, and no measured outcome in this sheet. It is a design panel, not an evaluation panel, until per-figure source data are recovered.

acquisition_queue.why: repair-dependent insertion behaviour; read-count tables released
acquisition_queue.blocking: pooled insertion rates are library-abundance normalised, not per-design edited-allele fractions; long inserts may exceed the 90-token pegRNA input
acquisition_queue.fields_to_recover: accession, replicate, cell line, MMR status, insert sequence, read counts, library abundance denominator

acquisition_queue.why: original endogenous measurements from a different group; the plan's first choice for external selection
acquisition_queue.blocking: usable row counts require supplement extraction; restrict to the single-pegRNA configuration this model supports
acquisition_queue.fields_to_recover: guide, target window, cell line, editor, replicate, efficiency denominator

acquisition_queue.candidate: PRIDICT2 / ePRIDICT endogenous and chromatin panels (PRJNA1025026)
acquisition_queue.why: assay-shift test; endogenous rather than reporter
acquisition_queue.blocking: the same source family already contributes 174,067 training rows, so only panels proven absent from training qualify; external/pridict2/dataset holds the 23k processed library and a ranking-percentile table, both of which need an overlap audit against the training mix before use
acquisition_queue.fields_to_recover: endogenous vs mapped-reporter flag, integration site, coordinates, replicate identity

acquisition_queue.why: position and chromatin-state effects at mapped integration sites
acquisition_queue.blocking: few shared reporter designs, so probably cannot support alternative-pegRNA selection; mechanistic validation only
acquisition_queue.fields_to_recover: integration site, chromatin annotation provenance, perturbation

acquisition_queue.why: matched-design endogenous panel from a training-adjacent source
acquisition_queue.blocking: no efficiency column in the released sheet; needs per-figure source data
acquisition_queue.fields_to_recover: measured efficiency per design per figure panel, replicate, cell

acquisition_queue.blocking: readout is guide abundance/fitness, not editing efficiency; do not use as an efficiency label
acquisition_queue.fields_to_recover: phenotype readout definition, genotype confirmation subset

reserved_panel.seal_note: Written and hashed without any model being run on it. The first evaluation on this panel must be a pre-declared comparison; any earlier use turns it into development data.
